description: This file declares data structures, constants, and function prototypes for Voice Activity Detection (VAD) in an audio processing system, specifically for Wideband VAD.

methods.name: wb_vad_init
methods.description: Initializes the VAD state structure and allocates necessary resources.

methods.name: wb_vad_reset
methods.description: Resets the VAD state to default values.

methods.name: wb_vad_exit
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the VAD state.

methods.name: wb_vad_tone_detection
methods.description: Performs tone detection on the VAD state.

methods.name: wb_vad
methods.description: Performs voice activity detection on input buffer.
